content: Ananyao aneno wusyin Yahudi
Naije vatano Parisije inta nawe, kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa raije inta nawe, una no Yerusalem ude Yesus ai, wo anajo ware,
“Veanimaibe irati Nya arakovo utavondi naije wo aneno wusyine awa ananyao rakanyoandi? Arono wisyisy, wo mana veano maneme rarondom datije ramu, ti mamaisye ramu!”
Umba Yesus po raura nakananto mai pare, “Wabeanimaibe irati wapo Amisye apa ananyaowe rakanyoandi, yara watavondi wapa aneno wusyine awa ananyao bo rai?
Maisyare so: Amisye po raura pare, ‘Mbeaje irati inya pe nangkoya me yai,’ muno pare, ‘Are pirati po aja pe akoya me yaura tatugadi, opamo mangke raugaje ai indamu kakai.’
Yara wapa ananyao nsasye, weye wapare, ‘Are pirati pare po apa ananuge raunanto Amisye bo ai,

vemo po ana inta raunanto aja pe akoya me yai jinya.’ Maisyare omaisy, wapare vatano napije po aja pe akoya me yaeranande aya bekedaije rai jewen kai. Maisyare omai ti, wapo wapa ananyao raijaseo ntiti rave mo ayao Amisye rakivan.
Weapamo wapa angkarije ntapekan! Yesaya po raura tugae rave arono wusyinoe po wasaura taiso:

content.text: ‘Vatane so wo rinararimbe mawa bo rai,
Usambayambe Rinai, weramu ama ine meweno rai,
weye wo Risya ananyao ranigwano vatane awa bo rai.’”

content: Ana nggwamo vatane mansai
Yesus po vatano wanuije mawainde umba Po raura nanto mai pare, “Wadanide! Syare wananta Sya ayaowe so rai.
Anaisyo wadaisye mi mo wasaveti wagwambe Amisye amune raija jewen. Yara wapa ana wadaura, muno wadaijar omi mo wasaveti wagwambe no Amun.”
Umba Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije ude wo raura Ai ware, “Injae, Nya ana nyo raura umaso mamo mo vatano Parisi manuga ratukam ti upari.”
Umba Yesus po ananeneae inta raura nakananto mai pare, “Vatano Parisi maurata irati anareo Sya Injayo no no munijo ntiti Po rayanyume ramu, weti pare Po rapatin po raepata.

Weti vemo wapo vatano Parisi maraniv nora, yara wapo mapaya kai. Wenao maurata irati vatano amije ntuba inta be akarive vatano mamije ntuba kaijinta mai. Vatano amije ntuba inta po vatano amije ntuba kaijinta augav no aya unanui anya rai, weamo mamaisye ramu, weaveti itatayasyo ateme rai kava.”
Umba Petrus po raura pare, “Injae, syare Nyo ananeneae umawe raura kakavimbe reansai.”
Umba Yesus po raura nakananto mai pare, “Wabeanimaibe wananta raije jewen?
Anaisyo wadai no wasawa omamo mo wanyatije raijasyo ti wapo rangkarave ti mewen.
Yara ana ntipu no wasanuga umba muje no wasawa omirati mo wasaveti wagwambe Amisye amune rai.

Weye ana ntipu no vatane manuga umba muje omamo awa ana udatantona kotaro kakai, wo vatane maubaisy, unakijo awa arakove awa wanya marijat, anaerere ugavo mansai, wanaonoambe, wayarurijabe vatane mai, muno wo vatane maura tantunawi.
Ana umaso mirati mo vatane maveti ugwambe Amisye amune rai. Yara vatane wisyisye me maneme rarondom me omi vatane ubeta rai jewen ti ugwambe Amisye amune raija jewen.”
Wanya Kanaan inta manave Yesus ai
Yesus puje munijo we raora umba poroto no munijo Tirus muno Sidon.

Umba wanya inta no no naije, omamo wanya Yahudi jewen, yara wanya Kanaan. Wanya Kanaan umaso nde irati Yesus ai, nggwain mare, “Injae, Daud apa ajavijo Winy, naemeno rinai! Sya wanya arikainye mamo anawayo kakaije nsiso rai ti njoram dave.”
Weramu Yesus po ana inta raura nakananto raije ramu. Weti Apa arakovo utavondi aije ude Ai, wo anajo ware, “Injae, Nyo wanya wato ratuti da nin, weye mo wansarijat muno nggwain tutir no wansakiri.”
Umba Yesus po raura nanto mai pare, “Amisye po inatutir indamu ride vatano Israel obo mansai, weye onawamo maurata domba awa vatano po maeranande meweno mai.”
Weramu wanya umawe nde mo vukane ranteter no Yesus amun, muno mo raura nanto Ai mare, “Injae, naemeno rinai!”
Umba Yesus po ananeneae inta raura nakananto rai pare, “Wamare wamo anaisye inta rapatimu arikainye awaura rai, omamo arikainye awa nti vemo raeparaje vayave make mansai ramu.”
Wanya umawe mo raura nakananto Yesus ai mare, “Injae, tugae. Weramu anaisyo arikainye wo raisy ama kukupe inta ntatae no meja ama ate, weamo make wo rai kai.”
Umba Yesus po raura nakananto rai pare, “Ingkoe, syo naen nya anave manakoe rave. Weti Syo nya mbekedaije raunande.” Naije kobe wanya arikainyo anawayo kakaije nsiso raije umawe nsauman kobe.
Yesus po saumane raunanto vatano wanene kotare nande mai mansai
Umba Yesus puje, pakato panya nayave vono onae Galilea rai. Umba seo tuna no pukam.

Vatano Yahudi jewen wanui rave ude wo awa vatano ugwaneno wanene kotare raije maugavere no Yesusa nui: vatano majoe nsurukije nawe, vatano mamije ntuba nawe, vatano tunaive nawe, vatano mawa ngkao nawe, vatano kaijinta wanui wo maugavere Yesus ai. Umba wo maveaje utantuna no Amun, muno Po saumane raunanto mai.

Vatano wanuije umaso unantaive rave, weye wo vatano mawa ngkao maeno wayao akato, muno vatane tunaive seo tet akato, muno vatano majoe nsurukije wanya kobe akato, muno vatano mamije ntuba wo ana raen akato. Weti wo vatano Israel awa Amisye ararimbe.
Yesus po anaisye raunanto vatane ribuge mambisya wo raisy

Umba Yesus po apa arakovo utavondi aije mawainde, umba Po raura pare, “Rinaemeno vatano wanuije so mansai rave. Soamo utavono Rinaija masyote mandei to, ti awa anaisye meweno mai, umaror. Syonae syo matutir unaji bayavei, weye indati marore po mansaveti mamune ngkaumudi no unanuije ama yasyin.”
Yesus apa arakove umaso wo raura nanto Ai ware, “Nugo vabukane vono maninimbe so anaisye mewen dai. Weti rui rati nyare wamo anaisye rakani ti mamaisyo vatano wanui rave so mansai?”
Umba Yesus po manajo pare, “Wapa rotije ruimaisy?” Umba wo raura nakanande Ai ware, “Vasyesye kaururuma mi ntuna, jiano tuvane inta matavon.”
Umba Yesus po vatano wanuije umaso matutir utantuna no kopa vone rai.

Umba Po rotije vasyesye kaururum muno jiane umawe raugav, umba Po kove raura seo Amisye ai. Umba Po raporadijo aneme rai, Po raunanto Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai, indamu wo ratodijo vatano wanuije umaso mai.
Wo raisya uman dave tenambe. Umba Yesus apa arakove wo anaisye ama ateteo ntuna ranugan akasyo bayaije kaururum ntatairi.
Anya uma wo anaisye umaso raisye awa wanuije nanto no ribuge mambisy. Awa wanya muno awa arikainyo wo anaisye umaso rai tavon, weramu awa wanuije ratore ramu.
Yesus po vatano wanuije umaso matutir unajiv, umba seo nyomane rai, poroto no munijo Magadan.

footnotes.text: Ananeneae somamo arikainye maurata irati vatano Yahudi mansai, muno make maurata irati vatano Yahudi jewene mansai.
